features.name: Engine core loop
features.description: remark→Block[] parse, pure React read-only render, hidden-textarea input isolation, sync line writeback, caret coords

checklist: parseMarkdown: content → Block[] (heading/paragraph/code/quote/list/hr)
BlockRenderer: pure React read-only render + data-block-id + onClick
HiddenTextarea: 1x1 transparent textarea, absolute-positioned to cursor, sole input entry
caretFromPoint: click block → compute blockId + offset
pointFromCaret: block+offset → pixel coords → position textarea
onChar: char insert → displayText op → textToMarkdown → sync → re-parse
Enter: insert \n\n → re-parse → caret to new block
Backspace: delete char at offset-1 (empty-block merge: done in C-03)
Arrow Left/Right: offset ±1 + reposition
Arrow Up/Down: switch block + offset=0
IME: compositionStart→flag, compositionEnd→onChar

features.name: Engine block visual styles
features.description: Per-block-type visual rendering: quote left border, code dark-bg, list bullets, table grid

checklist: QuoteBlock: border-l-4 left border + indent + muted text
CodeBlock: dark background light text pre/code + language label
ListBlock: ul/ol list style + task checkbox (read-only)
TableBlock: table grid lines + header style
All blocks retain data-block-id + onClick (clickable to edit)

features.name: Engine keyboard completion
features.description: Backspace empty-block merge, Delete key, arrow keys preserve column, Enter line number verification

checklist: Backspace empty block: delete the block
Backspace non-empty at block start: merge into previous block end
Delete: delete char at offset
Delete at line end / empty block: merge next block
Arrow Up/Down: preserve approximate column position
Enter: caret line number matches actual block

features.name: Engine block-type editing behaviors
features.description: Quote Enter continues >, List Enter continues -/1., Code Enter newline without exit, Table Tab moves cells

checklist: Paragraph/Heading Enter: \n split, caret to new line
Paragraph/Heading Backspace empty: deleteLine, caret to prev
Paragraph/Heading Backspace line-start: merge into prev block
Paragraph/Heading Delete line-end: merge next block
Quote Enter: continues > prefix
Quote Backspace/Delete: sibling merge with boundary protection
List: Enter continues -/1. prefix
List: Tab/Shift+Tab indent/dedent
Table: Tab moves cells, Enter adds row
Code: Enter newline within block, no exit
Blank lines: rendered as editable empty paragraphs
